sourceTitle: The Free Lances: A Romance of the Mexican Valley
description: "The Free Lances: A Romance of the Mexican Valley" by Mayne Reid is a historical novel written in the mid-19th century. The story follows Florence Kearney, a young Irishman, who is drawn into the tumultuous events leading up to the Texas Revolution after encountering a recruiting poster calling for volunteers to fight against Santa Anna's forces.
